subtitle: Tracking Florida's 2026 property tax elimination proposals and related reforms
current_status_summary: The May 20, 2026 Florida Senate bill-actions page reviewed for this tracker reported no bill actions that day. Earlier Florida Senate bill-actions notices reviewed for this tracker stated the Senate would convene on May 12, 2026, at 10:00 AM for Special Session E. CS/CS/HJR 203 passed the Florida House but died in Senate Appropriations during the regular session. The issue could return through a later special session or a new joint resolution.
